PS Description: Build an AI academic assistant that does not blindly answer every question. Your task is to design an intelligent decision layer that evaluates incoming student queries and determines whether to answer directly, ask for clarification, request more context, or indicate insufficient confidence. Focus on query intent, safety/guardrails, and decision-making over raw model fine-tuning.

College issues often remain unreported because students feel reporting will not lead to real action. Design a web solution that improves the complete journey from reporting a campus issue to verification, prioritization, status tracking, and feedback. Focus on building student trust, workflow integrity, and priority mechanics rather than a basic complaint form.

Given anonymized student activity data, discover a meaningful, non-trivial pattern, relationship, anomaly, or insight that college administrators may not already know. Clean the dataset, formulate your own analytical hypotheses, and present data-backed findings with clear visualizations. Focus on insight depth and data storytelling.

You are given access to an intentionally vulnerable web application. Identify the security vulnerabilities present, demonstrate how they can be exploited, calculate their risk impact, and provide exact source-code fixes/remediations to eliminate the security flaws. Focus on root-cause understanding, manual exploitation proof, and secure code fixes.

You are provided with a basic 3-tier web application (Frontend, Backend REST API, and Database Schema). Host and deploy the complete application stack so it is publicly accessible over the internet with working HTTPS URL(s). Focus on clean GitHub version control, environment variable management, CORS/networking configuration, and deployment architecture decisions.

Identify a high-frequency campus situation where a student has very little time or attention, and design a mobile application experience that lets them complete the important task within 30 seconds. Focus on minimizing user friction, zero-latency micro-UX, instant state caching, and intuitive design over multi-screen navigation.
